question: How many films are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: List the titles of all films rated G. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rating = 'G'

question: What is the length in minutes of the longest film?
gold_sql: SELECT max(length) FROM film

question: Return the first and last names of all staff members.
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM staff

question: How many distinct film ratings exist?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT rating) FROM film

question: List the titles of films with a rental rate of 4.99 that are longer than 180 minutes. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 4.99 AND length > 180

question: What is the email address of the customer Mary Smith?
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE first_name = 'MARY' AND last_name = 'SMITH'

question: Which city is store 1 located in? Return only the city name.
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city FROM store s JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id WHERE s.store_id = 1

question: List the titles of all films in the Action category. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Action'

question: Return the first and last names of the actors who appear in the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: What language is the film ALIEN CENTER in? Return only the language name.
gold_sql: SELECT l.name FROM film f JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id WHERE f.title = 'ALIEN CENTER'

question: How many customers live in India?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'India'

question: List the distinct titles of films available in the inventory of store 2. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.title FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE i.store_id = 2

question: List the titles of science fiction films. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sci-Fi'

question: What is the total revenue from all payments?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment

question: For each film rating, what is the average rental rate rounded to 2 decimal places? Return the rating and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT rating, round(avg(rental_rate), 2) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total payment amount? Return the customer_id and their total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many films are in each category? Return the category name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: How many rentals did each staff member handle? Return the staff_id and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT staff_id, count(*) FROM rental GROUP BY staff_id

question: How many films feature more than 10 actors?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT film_id FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id HAVING count(*) > 10) s

question: What is the average film length per category, rounded to 1 decimal place? Return the category name and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, round(avg(f.length), 1) FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Which film rating has the most films? Return only the rating.
gold_sql: SELECT rating FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are registered at each store? Return the store_id and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, count(*) FROM customer GROUP BY store_id

question: Return the distinct first and last names of customers who rented the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT cu.first_name, cu.last_name FROM customer cu JOIN rental r ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: Which category generated the most payment revenue? Return only the category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the titles of films that have never been rented. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: Which actor appears in the most films? Return the actor's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the titles of Comedy films that are longer than the average length of all films. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy' AND f.length > (SELECT avg(length) FROM film)

question: Which country has the most customers? Return the country name and the customer count.
gold_sql: SELECT co.country, count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each rating, return the rating and the title of its longest film (include ties).
gold_sql: SELECT rating, title FROM film f WHERE length = (SELECT max(length) FROM film f2 WHERE f2.rating = f.rating)

question: Return the monthly revenue across all payments: the month formatted as YYYY-MM and the total amount for that month.
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(amount) FROM payment GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers have rented from both store 1 and store 2, based on the store of the inventory they rented?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT r.customer_id FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY r.customer_id HAVING count(DISTINCT i.store_id) = 2) s

question: Which 3 films have been rented the most times? Return the title and the rental count, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, count(*) AS rentals FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY rentals DESC, f.title LIMIT 3
